name: NGINX Open Source Static Server
free_limit: Self-hosted BSD-2-Clause open-source HTTP server for static HTML, CSS, images and files, with virtual hosts, caching and reverse proxy; no vendor-imposed site, traffic or request quota in the OSS software.
watch_out: You provide and pay for hosting, storage, bandwidth, DNS, TLS configuration and maintenance. F5 NGINX Plus and enterprise support are separate paid offerings; the free software is not a hosted plan.
